report_topic: Working of Madhya Pradesh State Agro Industries Development Corporation Limited
observations_summary: The audit found that the Madhya Pradesh State Agro Industries Development Corporation Limited failed to achieve its core objectives, including underutilization of its Mechanized Agricultural Farm and non-development of agro-industries. Significant financial mismanagement was observed, leading to operational losses, non-recovery of dues, idle funds, and an avoidable tax burden, alongside deficiencies in procurement, quality control, and internal control systems.
